title: Tight precision and confidence reduce quarter-log loss constant to2048

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total deterministic P family family.evaluate in proof.md. At actual N>=2 set n=N,L=ceil(log2 N),B=ceil(log2(L+1)),Z=ceil(L^(3/4))*ceil(B^(1/4)),E=2048Z,Kmin=2^(E/2),k=Kmin^2. Use t=2^(ceil(L^(1/4))*ceil(B^(3/4))), independent active gap q=ceil(sqrt(ceil(L/B))), ell=2^(ceil(sqrt L)*ceil(sqrt B)),Pmax=2^ceil(61Z/10). All tree intervals[floor(iN/t^j),floor((i+1)N/t^j)) partition actual inputs exactly. Fields, small-error precision181/5000, row/block-source maps, numerical guards and fallback0 are supplied. No advice, target padding, ignored input bits, oracle or witness is used.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this ONE fixed total uniform P language, hence NP with empty witnesses, there exists N0 such that for EVERY integer N>=N0, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-8*2^(2048Z)+4, where L=ceil(log2 N),B=ceil(log2(L+1)),Z=ceil(L^(3/4))*ceil(B^(1/4)). The loss is2^((2048+o(1))*(log2 N)^(3/4)*(log2(log2 N))^(1/4)). For this SAME fixed family, for EVERY fixed real epsilon>0 there exists N_epsilon such that C_B2(F_N)>=4N-N^epsilon for EVERY integer N>=N_epsilon. Thus liminf C_B2(F_N)/N>=4 over ALL integer lengths. Complete supplied arguments prove deterministic fields/Singer construction, seed-aware SU strong extraction, precision181/5000 transfer extraction, affine row/block-source reduction with errorK^(1/167), independent-gap tree dispersion and unrestricted full-B2 transfer at actual length. All input bits and affine deficiencies are charged. No explicit threshold, practical full asymptotic evaluation, literature record, prior verdict or external retrieval premise is claimed.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
